newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU to probe aid to Dutch Oce - paper.
newsitem.headline: EU to probe aid to Dutch Oce - paper.

text.p: The European Commission will announce an investigation into a state subsidy paid to Dutch photocopier and printer maker Oce van der Grinten, newspaper Het Financieele Dagblad said on Tuesday.
The paper said the Commission will announce on Wednesday a probe into 25 million guilders given to the company by the Dutch government for research into digital copiers.
The aid was intended for research into the commercial feasibility of the copiers and was to be paid back once the product was launched onto the market.

But the state grant seems to have exceeded the limit of 40 percent of total costs stipulated by Commission regulations and had also been used to subsidise research into developing existing technologies, the paper added.
